instruction: A candid documentary photograph in a medium-full, eye-level shot captures an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpeted floor and white walls. The woman in the white patterned t-shirt (R2) stands on the left in blue jeans, leaning playfully and extending her right arm horizontally while smiling. Next to her, the man in the black cap (R1) stands on the right in a dark polo shirt and blue shorts, smiling as he raises his right hand behind her head to make a playful bunny ears gesture. The scene is brightly lit by overhead lights, highlighting the white walls, a radiator, and the red carpet.
